Fair divisions at your own level

8 Divisions

The competition has 8 different individual levels to play:
– Diamond
– Platinum
– Gold / Masters 35+
– Silver / Masters 45+
– Bronze
– Iron
– Youngsters (12-17y)
– Teens (12-17y)
With the Placement Event, you will be placed into one of the 8 divisions, You can’t choose!

Masters 35+ years old can choose to participate in the regular divisions or in the Masters division.

*NEW*
In 2026, we’re adding 3 Buddy Divisions to the competition (see below)

6 months

Season 10 runs from Sept until Feb. Every month one event with two workouts!

Welcome at the Finals

Live event

The best athletes of each division after the online events will be invited to the live finals at April 3rd & 4th 2027 at Sportcentrum Valkenhuizen, Arnhem (NL). The number of athletes per division will be based on the total number of athletes in each division. More athletes = more finalists in that division.

*New* Compete together

Nationals Buddy

In 2026, we’re adding the Buddy Divisions to Season 10. This is a competition with 2-person teams. For the buddies, there are three divisions:
– Blue Division
– Red Division
– Black Division

Both buddies perform the individual Placement Workouts. Based on their score, they will be placed in one of the three divisions. All 4 online workouts need to be done together. These workouts are buddy variations of the Individual Online Season workouts. Buddy teams can consist of 1 Males + 1 Female, 2 Males or 2 Females.

The division for teenagers

12 – 17 years old

For the young athletes, there are two special Divisions: Teens & Youngsters Division. Are you 12-17 years old? Then you can get a Teens-ticket with permission of your parents.

These athletes will be placed into the Teens or Youngster division, based on their placement results.

Teens: dumbbell 10/5kg, single unders, knee raises
Youngsters: dumbbell 15/10kg, double unders, toes to bar

The division for masters

35+ years old

Since Season 8 we’re adding two Masters Categories:
– 35+ years old (Gold level)
– 45+ years old (Silver level)

You can register for these divisions by buying a Masters Ticket. You have to be the age of the age group on October 18th 2026. Just like in the Teens and Youngsters divisions, there will be 1 workout (no separate levels within the division). Masters choose for their division but also have to perform the Placement.

Masters 35+ will have the same workouts as Gold, Masters 45+ will have the same workouts as Silver. If these levels are too high for you, you can join in the regular divisions.
